description: Prices a given number of inboxes at WarmInboxes' published prices: the domains (or Azure tenants) they sit on, daily sending capacity at the provider's pace, monthly cost and delivery time. Use it when the person already knows the count ("preview 100 inboxes"); for a send volume use plan_infrastructure. Azure is sold by the tenant, so a count that does not fill one is quoted for the tenants it needs, with a note. A quote only: it orders nothing, and the exact preview with real domain and mailbox names is in the app or on WarmInboxes Infrastructure MCP.

billing.description: Prewarmed commitment length. Longer is cheaper. Defaults to monthly.

prewarmed.description: true for prewarmed inboxes, false for fresh (14-21 day warmup, cheaper). Defaults to true.

provider.description: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or Azure (Microsoft tenants). Defaults to google.

name: quote_inboxes
title: Price a number of inboxes (quote)
